title: German-Style Grape Fritters
description: Delicious crispy fritters filled with sweet grapes, perfect as a dessert or snack.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, nutmeg, baking powder, and sugar.
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together milk, eggs, and melted butter.
3. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
4. Gently fold in the grapes and chopped nuts.
5. Heat about 2-3 inches of oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
6. Using a spoon, drop small balls of the batter into the hot oil, about 1 tablespoon each.
7. Cook the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
8. Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate.
9. Dust the fritters with powdered sugar and serve warm.
10. Enjoy your delicious German-style grape fritters!
